verdict.rationale: The evidence shows two deployment models, but neither matches this hybrid story. Trigger.dev Cloud is a managed compute platform where your task code runs on the vendor's infrastructure, which one user contrasts with Inngest because Trigger.dev code is hosted 'on their server'. Self-hosting means running and managing the entire platform yourself, so the vendor does not manage the control plane. Nothing in the pack documents bring-your-own workers connected to a vendor-managed orchestration plane.
